poin.isi: Barclays is scaling Claude across its global operations (Oct 1): a knowledge assistant for 16,000 colleagues, and Claude now routes about 120,000 emails a day in its Global Markets division.
The rollout is gradual and specific: one clear task first, measured, then expanded. Barclays expects half its developers to use Claude Code by the end of 2026.
Start with the single repetitive task that eats the most time, measure the result, then add more. Useful agents come from a clear process.

headline: AI AGENTS NOW DO REAL WORK
AT A MAJOR EUROPEAN BANK
headline_caption: Barclays: AI agents doing everyday work, not just a pilot.
subjudul: Barclays uses Claude (Oct 1): 16,000 staff supported, 120,000 emails routed daily.
